what:
Two non-blocking notes from the independent review of #14347 (merged 5b5e7ce). The manager's instruction was to fold them into the next change to src/runtime/order_monitor.py, not a PR of their own. Both were verified on main at a211c5aa5.
(a) Around line 9563, the comment on the top-up 'exit_deferred' result says 'no cooldown was left, so the next sweep retries'. That is wrong: the refused resting POST DID set the 900 s top-up cooldown, so the retry comes after the cooldown, not on the next sweep.
(b) The escalated_post_rejected counter (around line 9722) counts every falsy _attempt_naked_autoprotect result, including its several 'return False' paths that fail BEFORE any venue call (no client, and so on). A rejection the venue never saw is counted as a venue rejection, and it still spends one unit of the re-arm cap. Either split the counter (venue-rejected vs not-sent) or document that it means 'escalated post did not rest'.
(c) Found while observing the first deployed sweep line (2026-09-29 18:55:56Z, running sha a211c5aa5, MEASURED): checked=9, covered=7, and every other counter 0. That leaves 2 rows in no counter. One is explained by the same sweep's log (alpaca_paper/GLD 'skipping re-arm — an active close is in flight', 18:55:51Z). The other took one of the sweep's uncounted early 'continue' paths: the _NAKED_POSITION_GRACE_SECONDS fresh-fill grace, an empty symbol, the active-close skip, or no client. So 'checked' does not equal the sum of the outcome counters, and an uncounted skip is indistinguishable from a missing one. Add counters (grace_skipped, active_close_skipped, no_client) so the counters sum to 'checked'.
